fields.description: Human label so the issuer can recognize this token (e.g. 'ChatGPT read-only').
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The Frappe User this token acts as. Every action still runs under this user's two-axis ACL.
fields.label: User

fields.description: read = only side-effect-free explore/snapshot reads; write = every LLM-exposed capability (still floored by ACL).
fields.label: Mode

fields.description: JSON list of sheet ids this token is restricted to, e.g. ["acme"]. Empty = every sheet the user can reach.
fields.label: Sheets

fields.description: Keyed HMAC-SHA256 of the token secret. The plaintext is shown to the issuer exactly once and never stored.
fields.label: Token Hash

fields.description: After this instant the token is rejected (401). Set at issue from the TTL.
fields.label: Expires On

fields.description: Revoked tokens are rejected immediately. One-click kill switch.
fields.label: Revoked

fields.description: Stamped on each successful use, for audit / stale-token cleanup.
fields.label: Last Used At
